notes.title: Lost Drawings, New Features, & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Today's update brings new content & improvements.


[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]

- Lost drawings have been scattered over all courses, can you find them all? [i][b]These will only be visible upon unlocking other secrets in the game (make your way downstairs on the title map)[/b][/i].  Goodluck!

- New overworld song for the grotto course, but playable on all.

- New ending song with the option to disable in the title map club house.


[u][b]New Features & Improvements:[/b][/u]

- A couple secret shortcuts have been added to golf holes to allow a more consistent ace.  These will be rare to stumble upon & more will be added in future updates. 

- An option has been added in the title map club house to enable/disable hand disappearing when not in use.

- Sign now exists explaining arcade mode on the title map.

- A cursed barrel has been added in the lower level of the title map to reset all progress towards unlockables (golf balls, clubs, & art).


[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

- Snap turn bug has been fixed where it would sometimes leave the camera slightly faded after rotating.

- Lighthouse course club sensitivity disables on holes where power shots are required.

- Several other small miscellaneous bugs have been fixed.



Would have liked to bring you an update sooner but will try harder for the next! 


Thanks for playing & enjoy!

notes.title: Hand Update
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Quick update today for the hands' visibility.  

For those wanting to play with one controller, simply place the unused one on a flat surface and the hand will disappear when not in use.  The hand now also disappears when a club is picked up, for a more natural feeling of holding a club and not being in the way visually when taking a shot.

As a side note, the in-game resolution options have been removed. Sometime after these were added to the game, SteamVR acquired additional functionality to override resolution per game.

Thanks for playing!

notes.notes:
